title: Assessment Tentative Roll (2020)
description: Data Dictionary: Label Definition print_key Abbreviated tax identification number (section-block-lot) parcel_location_address The parcel address of the property. prop_class The number of property class that this property falls within. own_owner_name The primary owners first and last name (or the name of the LLC or agency that owns the property). own_attention_to The person or role that the assessment is addressed to. own_po_box The P.O. box of the owner, if applicable own_street_address The property owner's street address. own_city_state_zip The property owner's city, state, and zip code. sch_taxable The taxable value of the property according to the local school district. muni_taxable The taxable value of the property according to the local municipality (City of Syracuse). cnty_taxable The taxable value of the property according to the local county (Onondaga County). total_av The taxable value of the property according to the Assessment Department. Full Value The full value of the property. Dataset Contact Information: Organization: City of Syracuse Position: Data Program Manager Email: opendata@syr.gov City: Syracuse, NY
match_method: Official DCAT item ID and sublayer resolved through ArcGIS item metadata to the source URL.
limitations: City-hosted data: DataCuse indexes metadata and links to the original service; it does not mirror these records.
Portal membership does not establish completeness or currency. Source-check dates are not observation dates.
Related views and editions may overlap; do not add their counts.
